name: hud_ui_triplet_constructor
description: HudUiTriplet::Constructor initializes the scoreboard triplet container, creates the header and row-cell panels, assigns default text/layout state, hides child panels, and enables the container.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this HUD triplet constructor; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HUD triplet/source-cluster pass.

The native triplet constructor smoke verifies header labels and alignment, all row-cell allocations, enabled state, child head/tail linkage, and default layout/font fields.
